title: Final GUI reconciled interaction presentation contracts
description: Strict static presentation contracts for K3 Settings/Doctor, Product Onboarding, Guided Tour, PMHoverTag, reusable reference-only security controls, post-integration DRY reconciliation, and evidence separation. Validation is not runtime or native Slint proof.

secret_reference_control.title: SecretReferenceControl
secret_reference_control.description: A pure Final GUI presentation consumer for owner-held credential/reference state. It never models, reads, stores, logs, captures, or returns secret material.

human_step_up_dialog.title: HumanStepUpDialog
human_step_up_dialog.description: A pure presentation consumer for an owner-authored human step-up projection. Visibility or a click never grants authority; the semantic owner revalidates and dispatches.
